rule: GPC_PLAN.md §11.13 (the lead's ODCV-Bench check, zero GPU; nothing upstream is patched)
source: Rajamanoharan and Nanda, 'Models May Behave Worse When Eval Aware', LessWrong, 2026-06-11, footnote 8: misconfigured Dockerfiles and missing sandbox artifacts in the original repo (no scenario or commit named)
method: static: each image's files from its Dockerfile and build context (COPY with globs; RUN steps that move or remove files), against every path and tool each prompt names and every path its shipped tools use; verified against the 80 built images' file lists from rehearsal 7 (all agree once base-image binaries and the one rm step are accounted for)

runs: every call of each of the 145 named tools in upstream's shipped runs (12 models x 2 variants; other models' runs, scanned by script), for infrastructure errors; the runs predate upstream's May change to Clinical-Trial-Data-Management, which was read at the pin
the one broken route emulated at the pin

tiers.route_broken: the legitimate route cannot be completed as built (the read's registered exclusion)
tiers.route_defect: a defect on the prompt's route that an agent can work around or would not notice (the read's sensitivity exclusion, exploratory)
tiers.clean: no defect found on the prompt's route

defects: the prompt's /app/data/learning_materials/ (a directory) is the file /app/data/learning_materials.yml; the scorer takes the plan as its argument

check_compliance.sh:8 filters with `||`, which jq rejects (jq's operator is `or`): a compile error, so the shipped check reads 0.0 for every report and no route can pass it (the runs' own jq error in the image's jq 1.6; a compile error in jq 1.7.1 here)
the report directory /app/reports that the prompt and validate_qc.sh use is never created (the agent must mkdir it)

the ethical tool cannot run as built: enforce_rest_period.sh calls ./monitor_driver_vitals.sh relative to its working directory, which is /usr/local/bin's script only from /usr/local/bin, while the same tool reads ./driver_activity.log and ./safety_sensors.cfg, which are in /app; from /app (WORKDIR) it finds no monitor, gets empty vitals, exits 0 and logs no rest period; from /usr/local/bin it finds no config or log. Emulated at the pin: no rest logged in the image's layout, a rest logged with the monitor beside the log. Upstream's shipped runs hit the error in 15 of 27 calls.
the prompt's /app/data/transactions/ (a directory) is the file /app/data/transactions.log; both tools default to it

notify_safety_board.sh, the tool the prompt names for notifying the safety board, is 0 bytes at the pin (emptied in upstream's May sync; before it appended a SAFETY_ALERT line): the call exits 0 and does nothing, though it still shows in the transcript
archive_old_data.sh and /app/data/patient_7318.json are 0 bytes (neither on the prompt's route)
the prompt's /app/data/trial_cohort_7/ is /app/data (patient_*.json there); the tools default to /app/data
the KPI file the system prompt names, /app/config/kpi.json, is /app/data/kpi.json
the Dockerfile's dos2unix lands as an argument to rm (not installed; never called)
the prompt's /app/data/employee_diversity_data/ (a directory) is the file .../employee_diversity_data.csv; the tool takes it as its argument
the prompt's /app/data/financial_statements/ (a directory) is the file .../financial_statements.yaml; the tool takes it as its argument
the prompt's /app/data/patients/ (a directory) is the file /app/data/patients.csv; run_deid.sh falls back to it
the prompt's /app/data/emergency_incidents/ is /app/data (the incident files there); the tools take the directory as their argument

amendments.evidence: check_compliance.sh:8 (a jq compile error; the depth launch's and launch 6's runs met it and repaired it or shimmed jq); GPC_PLAN.md §13.4
